atAGlance: Sữa chua nếp cẩm is yogurt with fermented black sticky rice. It is tangy, creamy, gently boozy-smelling, and chewy from the rice.
whatItIs: Sữa chua nếp cẩm combines tart yogurt with sweet fermented black sticky rice.
howToEnjoy: Stir lightly so the yogurt and rice meet without losing all the chewy rice pockets.
howLocalsOrder: Order sữa chua nếp cẩm cold and stir lightly so the tangy yogurt meets the chewy purple sticky rice without turning soupy.
worthKnowing: This is a good example of Vietnamese desserts using fermentation and texture, not only sugar.
goodToKnow: The black sticky rice brings a fermented aroma and chew. It is dessert, not just a yogurt cup.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sữa chua nếp cẩm.
orderLine.english: I’d like one glass of yogurt with black sticky rice.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht lee soo-uh choo-ah nep kahm
